subject: LuminaSys + Redwood: Mentor rotation & case-labs partnership proposal
messages:
From: Sam Wright <sam.wright@luminasys.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LuminaSys + Redwood: Mentor rotation & case-labs partnership proposal

Hi Laura,

Great meeting earlier this week — thanks again for the walkthrough of Redwood's Dedicated and Private options. LuminaSys has been piloting a partner-led enablement idea we think could accelerate SI ramp and increase joint delivery velocity: a 6-week mentor rotation paired with hands-on case labs that embed Redwood into common customer patterns (search augmentation, summarization pipelines, and large-context agents).

High-level ask: would Redwood partner with us to host a 3-month pilot (one region, up to 6 mentor slots) where your engineers/solution architects rotate as technical mentors for our consultants and co-deliver two customer-facing case labs? We believe this lowers time-to-first-deploy for SI teams and creates repeatable win patterns for both sides.

Attached is a short outline of the program and proposed metrics. Key questions for your team:
- Availability windows for rotations (we're aiming Sep–Nov)
- Which internal roles would you prefer to rotate (SA, runtime engineer, enablement lead)
- Any legal/contract considerations for a short pilot (MOU or SOW)

If this looks interesting, could we get a 30-minute sync next week? Suggested times are Tue/Wed morning PT.

Best,
Sam
Partnerships Lead, LuminaSys
[Attachment: luminasys-program-outline.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wright <sam.wright@luminasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LuminaSys + Redwood: Mentor rotation & case-labs partnership proposal

Sam —

Thanks for the clear proposal and for outlining the metrics (ramp time, deployment success, repeatable play adoption). This aligns closely with our partner enablement goals. I'm copying the key folks on our side so we can scope a practical pilot.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Availability: Sep start window works for us; we can do a rolling 6-week window.
- Roles: recommend 1 SA + 1 runtime engineer per rotation (3–4 day blocks) and an enablement lead to own curriculum continuity.
- Legal: a short MOU is fine to start; we'll need a stub SOW if there are billed deliverables.

Next steps from Redwood: Marissa will draft a pilot runbook and syllabus; Soojin will prepare a short enablement checklist and training prerequisites; Jonas will check regional hosting constraints if you want Dedicated capacity in us-west.

Can you send any customer-facing case lab ideas or datasets you want used (anonymized) so we can start drafting the lab exercises? Also confirm the LuminaSys POC for scheduling.

Thanks — I'll book a 30-minute slot for Tue 9:30am PT unless you prefer another time.

—Laura
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2029 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LuminaSys + Redwood: Mentor rotation & case-labs partnership proposal

Laura / team —

Love this. Drafting a lightweight pilot runbook and attached the initial syllabus to get everyone moving. My proposal for structure:

Week 0: Kickoff + environment prep (Redwood sandbox with tenant-level access for LuminaSys consultants)
Week 1–6: Two-week cadence of mentor rotations (3 days on-site or remote co-working, followed by 4 days of practice & deliverables) across 6 mentors total
Deliverables:
- Two repeatable case labs (search-augment demo; summarization + extraction demo) with test prompts and evaluation harnesses
- A troubleshooting playbook for common runtime issues (KV cache priming, batching strategies, quantization caveats)

Resource ask from LuminaSys: 2 anonymized datasets and 1 sample customer prompt set per case lab; access to any internal archetype docs you want mirrored.

I attached the syllabus and a template runbook. If legal wants the MOU language, Laura, happy to loop counsel but let's keep the first pass at operational detail between the teams.

Action items:
- LuminaSys: confirm datasets + POC by 7/26
- Redwood: finalize syllabus and share environment access plan by 8/2

I'll also propose two candidate mentor names for the rotation (one SA, one runtime lead) after internal availability checks.

Thanks — Marissa
Principal Manager, Partner Enablement, Redwood Inference
